input.request: Build Consent Receipt, a revocable consent-record page. Token name: Consent Receipt. Token symbol: CNST. The fixed total supply is 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1,000,000,000 * 10^18 base units), minted once to the deployer. ConsentReceipt lets a subject grant a service a consent receipt bound to a bytes32 policy hash and uint256 expiry; the subject may revoke it, and anyone can verify its current status without exposing document contents. Deploy on Sepolia and publish a page to issue, revoke and verify consent receipts.
input.context: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111); GitHub and IPFS are approved. Include Foundry tests and an independent adversarial review. Constructors use only address, uint256, bool or bytes32 arguments; the launch token constructor is zero-argument. foundry.toml must set bytecode_hash = "none". No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Subjects issue and revoke their own consents; verifiers only read state, and expiry is evaluated on reads without an operator.

draft.objective: Build and review CNST and ConsentReceipt, deploy them on Sepolia, then publish the live consent-receipt website.

steps.objective: Implement fixed-supply CNST and privacy-preserving consent receipt records.
Test subject-only revocation, policy binding, expiry and status reads.
Independently adversarially review authorization and record immutability.
Build the live consent issuance, revocation and verification page.
